import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { album } from "./album";

export const artist = defineTable("artist", {
    columns: {
        artistId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        name: col.varchar(120)
    },
    relations: {
        album: rel.hasMany(() => album)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
